revisedDocuments.specs/framework/requirements.md:
# Spec review

Users can select a folder of documents and review its Markdown documents as a set, navigating through a document tree while reading one document at a time.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Selecting a folder includes every Markdown file in that folder and all of its descendant folders in the review set.
2. The review panel shows the included documents in a tree that preserves their folder hierarchy and identifies the files that need review.
3. Selecting a document in the tree opens it in a single viewer. Selecting another document replaces the viewer's contents with that document.
4. Combined feedback includes comments for the current version of every document in the selected set, including documents that are not open. Comments on older versions are excluded, and each comment remains associated with its document.
5. The Reviewed and Approve actions apply only to the document currently open in the viewer. Using either action does not mark any other document as reviewed or approved.
6. A first-time document without a comparison baseline is shown without body change highlights. Body change highlights are available only when a baseline exists.
revisedDocuments.specs/framework/design.md:
# Design

## Review set and document tree

Selecting a folder creates a review set containing its Markdown files recursively, including those in descendant folders. The review panel presents the set as a document tree that preserves the selected folder's hierarchy. Each file entry shows its review status so the user can identify documents that still need review.

## Single document viewer

The panel has one document viewer alongside the tree. Selecting a file makes it the open document and loads its contents into that viewer; selecting another file replaces the displayed document. The selected tree entry and the viewer refer to the same open document.

Reviewed and Approve operate on the open document only. Their results update that document's status in the tree without changing the review or approval status of other documents in the set.

## Combined feedback

Combined feedback gathers comments across the entire selected review set, independently of which document is open. For each document, it includes only comments associated with that document's current version and excludes comments from older versions. The combined output groups comments by document and identifies the document and version they apply to.

Combining feedback does not mark documents as reviewed or approved. Those actions remain scoped to the open document.

## Comparison baseline

The viewer uses a document's existing comparison baseline to show body change highlights. A first-time document without a baseline displays its Markdown body without change highlights; its entire body is not treated as a highlighted addition. Once a baseline exists, the viewer can highlight changes relative to it.
